topic: Prompt of the week: the smart-shopper prompt (as Google launches Universal Cart)
post:
Google just put an AI shopping cart inside Search and Gemini. 🛒
Before you let any AI help you buy, use this prompt.

This week Google launched Universal Cart in the US. It holds items from different stores in one cart, across Search (including AI Mode) and the Gemini app.

What it does 👇
🔔 Alerts you when a saved item drops in price or comes back in stock
🏷️ Looks for promo codes and card offers
🏬 Works with retailers like Target, Walmart, Sephora and Shopify sellers, who stay the seller of record

AI is getting good at the "buy" part. You still own the "should I?" part.

Prompt of the week 👇
"I'm thinking of buying [item] for about [budget]. Before I decide, ask me 3 questions about how I'll use it. Then compare 3 options in a table: price, key trade-off, and who it's best for. Tell me what you're unsure about, and what I should check myself before paying."

Why it matters:
Shopping agents make spending faster. This prompt makes you slower in the one place it counts: the decision. 🧠

Practical takeaway:
Save this prompt and run it before any purchase over $100. ✅

Would you let an AI agent check out for you? 👇
